summary.text: Cia Price is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 85, representing part of the city of Newport News, serving since 2016. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Privileges and Elections (chair), Health and Human Services, General Laws, and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Marcia S. "Cia" Price was born in Hampton, Virginia, according to the House's member profile.

The profile says she earned a B.A. in philosophy from Spelman College in 2002, an M.A. in religious studies from Howard University in 2005, and a Master of Divinity from Virginia Union University in 2022.
The profile lists her memberships as including Habitat for Humanity Peninsula and Greater Williamsburg (board member), Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority and the National Black Caucus of State Legislators.
It shows her chairing the Privileges and Elections Committee and the Health Professions Subcommittee of Health and Human Services.
